description: Use for "how are my campaigns doing?", "which campaign should I fix or give more budget?" or "where does each campaign lose buyers?". Returns each campaign (biggest spend first) with its share of budget, spend and ROAS, then every step from ad click to sale (clicked the ad, looked at a product, added to cart, went to checkout, sales) against similar stores, the one step where it loses the most buyers, what to do, the problem, the fix and what it could be worth in dollars. Same view as Campaigns in the Run1Ads app. Explain ROAS in plain words when the user may not know it.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. Leave it out to use your most recently updated brand.
